t3.title: {skill} · resonance
t3.effect: passive triggers 50% more frequently and grants +40 temporary barrier to nearest ally.
t3.flavor: “tactical synergy activated across team network :3”
t3.notes: proposed: each passive trigger gives the nearest other ally 40 barrier for 120 ticks, at most once per 150 ticks; internal passive cooldowns run at 67%

t5.title: {skill} · OVERCLOCK MASTER
t5.effect: passive effectiveness doubled; triggers an automatic retaliatory EMP pulse whenever health falls below 50%.
t5.flavor: “ABSOLUTELY BROKEN. defensive protocols pushed beyond regulatory limits!”
t5.notes: EMP pulse 4 m, 120 damage, interrupt, once per drop below 50% health

t3.title: {skill} · precision caliber
t3.effect: basic attacks apply 1 stack of bleed or stability shred on hit.
t3.flavor: “every basic hit leaves a nasty debuff imprint n__n.”
t3.notes: bleed 2 damage per tick for 90 ticks (strikers and operators) or +10 stability damage (breakers and bastions)

t5.title: {skill} · HYPER-VELOCITY BARRAGE
t5.effect: attack speed doubled; basic shots ricochet between up to 3 hostiles with zero damage falloff.
t5.flavor: “TURBO MACHINE-GUNNING. delete enemy cover and health in seconds!”
t5.notes: interval halved; each basic hit ricochets to the nearest unhit hostile within 5 m, up to three hostiles

t3.title: {skill} · rapid reload
t3.effect: power cost reduced by 4 and grants 2.0s haste upon activation.
t3.flavor: “cheaper, faster, cleaner execution uwu.”

t5.title: {skill} · DUAL CHARGE MATRIX
t5.effect: active skill gains a 2nd charge; casting both within 3s triggers a 360° concussive shockwave.
t5.flavor: “DOUBLE CAST READY! unleash relentless combo pressure on demand!”
t5.notes: shockwave 3 m, 120 damage around the caster

t3.title: {skill} · tactical focus
t3.effect: windup time reduced by 40% and grants immunity to interrupts while casting.
t3.flavor: “uninterruptible ultimate release. try stopping this, bestie!”
t3.notes: the signature windup cannot be interrupted, cancelled by exposure or by stun

t5.title: {skill} · APOCALYPTIC PROTOCOL
t5.effect: area radius / beam range expanded by 50%; inflicts dissociate on allies (invincible) and exposed on all hostiles hit.
t5.flavor: “TOTAL DOMINATION. flips lost teamfights in a single glorious frame!”
t5.notes: dissociate 45 ticks on allies inside the signature's area or line (the caster when it has neither)

t3.title: kinetic siphon
t3.effect: draining target speed grants 50% of the stolen move speed to aria.
t3.flavor: “your speed is now my sprint fuel, thanks bestie xo.”
t3.notes: aria gains 50% of the slow her momentum holds on a target as move speed for as long as it lasts

t5.title: absolute inertia collapse
t5.effect: reaching max stacks (15% slow) permanently grounds target, disabling dashes and blink skills.
t5.flavor: “sorry not sorry, your evasive maneuvers are officially cancelled :3.”
t5.notes: a target at maximum momentum is grounded (no dashes or blinks) while it stays there

t3.title: split flechette
t3.effect: arrow splits into two secondary micro-darts upon hitting the primary target.
t3.flavor: “double the needles, double the fun uwu.”
t3.notes: two darts at 30% damage fly on from the primary target at a seeded 15–35° either side, 4 m

t5.title: rail accelerator
t5.effect: arrow pierces cleanly through all enemies and destructible cover without stopping.
t5.flavor: “cover? what cover? my rail bolts do not acknowledge solid matter.”
t5.notes: the arrow pierces every enemy and passes destructible cover

t3.title: penta-spread fan
t3.effect: increases projectile count from 3 to 5 in an expanded 36° spread arc.
t3.flavor: “blanketing the entire lane in needle rain!”

t5.title: armor shred vortex
t5.effect: armor shred increases to -12 flat armor and resets needle storm cooldown if any enemy dies within 3s.
t5.flavor: “endless storm loop! delete them from the simulation entirely!”

t3.title: anti-materiel beam
t3.effect: beam width expands to 3m and obliterates crystal & stone cover instantly.
t3.flavor: “clearing sightlines for the squad in a single shot.”

t5.title: transcendent death ray
t5.effect: damage increased by +65%; targets below 35% health are instantly executed and trigger a 6m secondary nova.
t5.flavor: “ANNIHILATION COMPLETE. wipe their whole squad off the server board!”
t5.notes: damage +65 points of output percentage; nova 6 m, 200 damage

definition.name: Aria
definition.identity: Precision skirmisher who taxes movement, then deletes a slowed line with a hardlight rail.

passive.name: momentum tax
passive.text: Aria's basic and skill hits add one *Taxed* stack: −2% move speed per stack, up to 5 stacks, refreshed for 3 s by each hit.

aug.s: At 5 stacks the target is Slowed 30% for 1 s and the stacks reset; Aria gains 10% Haste for 2 s.

trans.s: A fully taxed target is Rooted for 0.8 s and takes +15% damage from Aria for 3 s. Once per target every 6 s.

basic.name: aimed arrow
basic.text: Free aimed flechette: 9 m, 0.18 m wide, 18 m/s, 72 damage and 6 stability.

aug.s: On hit the flechette splits into two shards at ±25° that travel 4 m for 40% damage each.

trans.s: Fires two flechettes 4° apart; the first pierces one target. Shards from the augment still split.

active.name: needle storm
active.text: Fan of 3 needles, 12° spread, 9 m, 0.22 m wide, 20 m/s; 110 damage and 8 stability each. Cost 18 · windup 0.73 s · cooldown 5 s.

trans.s: Seven needles across 36°; each pierces one target and applies Shred −4 armor for 4 s (stacks to −12).

signature.name: terminal vector
signature.text: Rooted windup, then a piercing hardlight round: 14 m, 0.3 m wide, 32 m/s, pierces 3; 320 damage and 25 stability. Cost 40 · windup 1.5 s · cooldown 16.5 s.

aug.s: Becomes an instant beam (class III), 1.2 m wide; deals ×2 structure damage, opening crystal and stone cover in one shot.

trans.s: Beam 21 m × 1.6 m, +60% damage. Targets below 35% health are executed and release a 6 m secondary nova (180 damage).
